ruleset.name: nitpicker-spring
ruleset.description: Nitpicker Spring rules: one allowed way for dependency injection, proxies, web, JPA and Spring Data.

rule.name: SpringBeanCollectionState

rule.name: SpringNoPostConstructIo
rule.message: Move startup work that calls a database or a remote service out of @PostConstruct, afterPropertiesSet or a @Bean initMethod (and the private helpers only they call) into an ApplicationRunner or an @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent). These run before the context is ready: there is no transaction around this call, other beans may not be proxied yet, and a failure stops the application from starting.
